scenarios.scenario_abstract: As studies begin to require a daily public-transport commute, [X] has about USD 80 for a backpack that must protect a 15-inch laptop, organize notebooks and chargers, remain comfortable, and survive repeated use; one named candidate is compared online and in store, including discounts, fit checks, and warranty value.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 随着学业安排开始要求每天乘公共交通通勤，[X]约有 80 美元购买背包；它需要保护 15 英寸笔记本电脑、收纳本子和充电器、背负舒适且能经受长期使用。[X]会围绕一款具体候选比较线上与门店，包括折扣、试背和保修价值。
examples: staying within the ceiling when the candidate meets the daily role
accepting a small premium after a clearly better fit test
waiting for an online deal when warranty and returns remain adequate

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before a two-week trip with some hiking, [X] looks for one travel backpack that balances a usable harness, durable water-resistant construction, secure access, and trail support, comparing seasonal sales and carefully inspected used options with paying more after an in-store fit test.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为一趟包含徒步的两周旅行寻找旅行背包时，[X]需要在合适的背负系统、耐用防泼水结构、安全取物和徒步支撑之间平衡；会比较季末折扣、仔细验过的二手选项，以及试背后为更合身的新品多付一些。
examples: buying on clearance when the harness and condition are verified
choosing used only after inspecting straps, zippers, and wear
paying more in store when fit materially changes long-distance comfort

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a two-week international trip by plane and taxi, [X] has roughly USD 200 for a 24-inch suitcase and judges whether lightweight shell material, reliable spinner wheels, a sturdy handle, a lock, and meaningful warranty coverage justify using more of that ceiling.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 准备乘飞机和出租车完成两周国际旅行时，[X]约有 200 美元购买一只 24 英寸行李箱，并会判断轻量箱体、可靠万向轮、结实拉杆、锁具和真正有用的保修，是否值得占用更多预算上限。
examples: prioritizing low empty weight when it may prevent airline fees
paying more for wheels and a handle that survive the planned trip
rejecting decorative extras when the warranty remains weak

scenarios.scenario_abstract: With approximately USD 600 available for a college laptop, [X] decides how much, if any, can remain for a protective bag after the computer is chosen, ranking basic protection alongside a mouse and storage accessories rather than treating every suggested add-on as mandatory.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]约有 600 美元用于购买大学学习所需的笔记本电脑，在电脑确定后才判断还能为保护电脑的包留出多少，并把基础保护与鼠标、外置存储等配件一起排序，而不是把每一项推荐附加品都当成必买。
examples: protecting the laptop with a simple bag inside the remaining total
postponing another accessory to afford better impact protection
using an existing bag when a new one would exceed the full setup budget

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While buying a first compact camera for a long world trip, [X] keeps the full setup near an approximately USD 500 budget and allocates money among the camera, a protective travel bag, spare power, memory, and optional filters according to damage risk and the intention to travel lightly.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为长期环球旅行购买第一台轻便相机时，[X]希望整套装备尽量接近约 500 美元，并会依据损坏风险和轻装需求，在相机、保护包、备用电源、存储卡与可选滤镜之间分配资金。
examples: funding a basic protective bag before an optional filter
choosing a smaller bag that fits the compact travel kit
avoiding a premium camera bag when it would force out essential power or storage

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While pricing a ten-day Ireland golf and countryside trip, [X] compares standard economy fares that include one checked bag with cheaper-looking alternatives and calculates whether the luggage allowance still offers better total value once the trip's clothing and equipment must be carried.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为一趟十天的爱尔兰高尔夫与乡村旅行核算费用时，[X]会把包含一件托运行李的标准经济舱与表面更便宜的替代票价比较，并在必须携带旅行衣物和装备的前提下判断哪种总价更划算。
examples: choosing the included checked bag when a lower base fare adds fees
packing within one allowance rather than paying for a second piece
taking the cheaper fare only when the necessary load fits its bag rules

scenarios.scenario_abstract: [X] tries to keep a Madrid-to-Palermo weekend near EUR 300 and therefore limits the carry system to small personal items, making any larger bag fee compete directly with two nights of lodging, local food, airport transport, and the single paid sight retained in the plan.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]试图把马德里到巴勒莫的周末旅行控制在约 300 欧元，因此把携带系统压缩到小型随身物品；任何更大行李的费用都必须直接与两晚住宿、当地餐食、机场交通和希望保留的一处付费景点竞争。
examples: using only the included small bag to protect the strict total
adding a larger bag only after the shared budget has enough room
dropping the trip rather than hiding an unavoidable bag charge

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After finding a cheap Ryanair flight for a seven-day Rome trip, [X] recalculates the real fare by deciding whether an under-seat personal bag is enough or a cabin trolley or checked case is necessary, while leaving seat selection and other optional fees out.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为七天罗马旅行找到一张便宜的瑞安航空机票后，[X]会根据座下小包是否够用、是否必须增加登机箱或托运行李重新计算真实票价，同时剔除选座等非必要收费。
examples: keeping the value fare when the week fits in the included bag
comparing trolley and checked-bag totals before booking
rejecting the apparent bargain when the necessary bag makes it costlier

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a long-distance relocation handled mostly by public transport, [X] caps the load at two carry-on-sized bags and one personal item, comparing the cost of obtaining a manageable carry system with shipping non-essentials and buying bulky basics after arrival from a separate soft-landing fund.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 进行一次主要依赖公共交通的长途搬家时，[X]把负载限制为两只登机尺寸行李和一个随身小包；会比较购置便于移动的携带系统、邮寄非必需品，以及从独立的落地安顿金中在到达后购买大件基础用品的成本。
examples: using workable bags already available and spending the fund after arrival
buying one easier-to-carry piece when it replaces a costlier shipment
shipping selected items rather than purchasing excessive luggage capacity

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While studying in Madrid, [X] regularly carries a EUR 1,500 laptop and peripherals through central-city cafes and compares several low-profile backpack tiers, judging price by padding, rear-facing storage, discreet appearance, water protection, and theft exposure that neither accidental-damage coverage nor ordinary home insurance fully removes.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在马德里学习期间，[X]经常在市中心的咖啡馆携带价值 1,500 欧元的笔记本电脑和外设，并比较多个价位的低调背包；价格判断依据包括缓冲保护、贴背收纳、不显眼外观、防水性，以及意外损坏保障和普通家财险都无法完全消除的失窃风险。
examples: choosing an urban mid-price bag with adequate hidden protection
paying a premium only when padding and organization materially improve
rejecting a conspicuous tech-branded bag despite its feature list
